tokens.name: --color-checkpoint

tokens.description: Coverage status: works. Same meaning as success, so it aliases it.

tokens.description: Coverage status: engine only. Muted so it does not read as a track colour.

tokens.description: Coverage status: planned. Neutral; no longer borrows warning.

tokens.description: Coverage status: mockup only. Muted so it does not read as the weather track.

tokens.name: --color-status-missing
tokens.description: Coverage status: missing. Same meaning as danger, so it aliases it.

tokens.name: --color-scene-camera

tokens.description: Text and icons on accent or danger fills; slider and toggle knob fill.

tokens.description: Status bar mode dot: Read only.

tokens.description: Dark square of the transparency checker behind a colour swatch (Colour field).

tokens.name: --text-icon-small
tokens.description: Icon glyph size in small icon buttons.

tokens.name: --text-micro

tokens.name: --text-display
tokens.description: Hero titles on full screens (library header, entry point).

tokens.description: Soft fill rule: a role colour at this opacity behind its own text (chips, pills, badges). Paper cannot mix a token with an opacity, so canvas soft fills are written as rgb() at 14%; code derives them from the role token.

tokens.name: --container-rail
tokens.description: Collapsed inspector rail width at the small breakpoint.

tokens.name: --spacing-focus-gap
tokens.description: Gap between a control and its focus ring, in the surface colour.

tokens.name: --spacing-xs
tokens.description: Smallest gap: icon to label in tight rows, chip padding.

tokens.name: --spacing-button-x
tokens.description: Left and right padding inside text buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: --spacing-splitter
tokens.description: Splitter hit area between the viewer and the timeline.

tokens.name: --spacing-border
tokens.description: Border width on panels, cards, fields, chips and dividers.

tokens.name: --spacing-stroke-curve
tokens.description: Easing curve and path stroke width.

tokens.name: --spacing-stroke-thin
tokens.description: Thin stroke: curve handles and small curve thumbnails.

tokens.name: --spacing-indicator

tokens.name: --spacing-tile

tokens.description: Side of a large tile or avatar (Page header page form, Avatar large).
